distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The handset came through a reseller, but the transfer was already updated to my direct subscriber record.
clue_answer: the transfer used the required direct ownership record
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the handset-purchase detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am trying to move my number across to your network.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can start that. Do you have the transfer code ready?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I received it by text yesterday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The number transfer completes only when its ownership record matches the required direct account holder; an intermediary record is rejected.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I checked the ownership record.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the billing address on file still correct?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that has not changed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like data roaming switched on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would be useful.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the number currently active and in use?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I am using it right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a confirmation message when it completes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, please send one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a paper bill as well?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, online only is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need international calling enabled?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I do not need that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the ownership record on the transfer match the required account holder?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The handset came through a reseller, but the transfer was already updated to my direct subscriber record.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you settled the balance with the old network?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that was cleared last week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the alternative contact ending in four-zero-three current?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that one still works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you want to keep the same monthly bundle?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the same one is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Send the transfer into the automated porting queue.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait and see what happens.

user_action.observation: While you were unavailable, I updated the transfer to the required direct ownership record.

port_status.not_started: the number transfer has not been submitted
port_status.in_progress: the transfer is in the porting queue
port_status.rejected: the transfer was refused by the porting process

causal_alignment.misaligned: the transfer carries an intermediary ownership record instead of the required direct record
causal_alignment.aligned: the ownership record matches the required direct account holder

pre_gap_actions.description: Send the transfer into the automated porting queue.
Give the user a brand new number instead of moving the old one.
Post out another SIM before the transfer is attempted.
Read the transfer code back once more before sending anything.
Close the request and ask the user to start again later.

post_gap_actions.description: Bring the stored account ownership details into line before trying again.
Push the identical transfer into the queue again now.
Read the transfer code back once more.
Leave the transfer alone and wait another interval.
Conclude that the completed operation succeeded, then close the request.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Thirty minutes have passed and the porting window ended, but the transfer result is not displayed. Based on the ownership detail I gave earlier, what should happen next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Does the ownership record on the transfer match the required account holder?
questions.gold_answer: the transfer used the required direct ownership record

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
